items.title: 5.4 Enzyme ke kaam ki raftar par asar dalne wale awamil (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.4, printed pages 131-133.

blocks.text: Enzymes us mahol (environment) ke liye bohat hassas (sensitive) hain jis mein woh kaam karte hain. Enzyme ki sargarmi par har woh tabdeeli asar dalti hai jo us ki chemistry aur us ki teen-jehti (three-dimensional) shakal badal de. Bunyadi awamil (factors) darja-hararat (temperature), pH, enzyme ki concentration aur substrate ki concentration hain.

Protein ki shakal un hydrogen bonds aur hydrophobic taalluqat (interactions) se tay hoti hai jo us ki polypeptide zanjeeron ko apni jagah rakhte hain, aur dono darja-hararat ki halki tabdeeli se aasani se toot jate hain. Har enzyme ek makhsoos darja-hararat, apne optimum temperature, par apni zyada se zyada raftar se kaam karta hai; insani enzymes ke liye yeh 37 degree Celsius hai.

blocks.alt: Reaction ki raftar (rate of reaction) aur 10 se 70 degree Celsius tak darja-hararat ka graph. Curve pehle aahista, phir tezi se barh kar taqreeban 37 degree par choti tak jata hai (nuqtedar lakeer), phir tezi se gir kar taqreeban 60 degree par sifar ho jata hai. Teer barhte hisse (Enzyme gains kinetic energy), choti (Optimum temperature) aur girte hisse (Enzyme being denatured) ki taraf hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.5: Darja-hararat (temperature) ka enzyme ki sargarmi par asar (kitab ki Figure 5.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen (left) taraf garmi barhne se molecules tez harkat karte aur zyada takrate hain, is liye raftar barhti hai. Choti optimum temperature hai (insani enzymes ke liye 37 degree Celsius). Is ke baad garmi enzyme ke bonds tor deti hai, us ki shakal bigar jati hai (denaturation) aur raftar tezi se gir kar taqreeban 60 degree par khatam ho jati hai.

Jab darja-hararat optimum se neeche girta hai to enzyme ki shakal tay karne wale bonds kam lachakdar ho jate hain. Woh active site mein us induced tabdeeli ki ijazat nahin dete jo enzyme ke kaam ke liye zaroori hai, is liye reaction ki raftar sust hoti hai. Jab darja-hararat ek had tak barhaya jaye to garmi activation energy mein izafa karti hai aur reactions tez hote hain; garmi substrate aur enzyme molecules ko kinetic energy bhi deti hai, to woh tezi se harkat karte hain, zyada takrate hain aur reaction ki raftar barhti hai. Jab darja-hararat optimum se kahin upar barhaya jaye to garmi enzyme molecule ke atoms ki thartharahat (vibrations) barhati hai; jab yeh bohat shadeed ho jayen to bonds polypeptide zanjeeron ko apni jagah nahin rakh pate aur globular banawat khatam ho jati hai. Yeh enzyme ki denaturation hai, jo enzyme ke kaam ki raftar mein tez kami laati hai aur use mukammal rok sakti hai.

blocks.title: Thermophilic bacteria
blocks.text: Thermophilic bacteria garam chashmon (hot springs) mein rehte hain. Un ke proteins ki polypeptide bazuon ke darmiyan bonding zyada mazboot hai aur woh 70 degree Celsius ya zyada par kaam kar sakte hain.

Tamam enzymes pH ki ek tang had ke andar apni zyada se zyada raftar se kaam karte hain. Is pH mein halka izafa ya kami enzyme ki sargarmi sust kar deti hai ya use mukammal rok deti hai. Har enzyme ek makhsoos pH, apne optimum pH, par behtareen kaam karta hai: pepsin tezabi (acidic) mahol (kam pH) mein faal hai, trypsin alkaline mahol (zyada pH) mein apni behtareen sargarmi dikhata hai, aur kuch enzymes jaise kachay papite ka papain tezabi aur alkaline dono maholon mein kaam karte hain.

Enzyme ki globular banawat mein polypeptide zanjeerein mukhalif charge wale amino acids, jaise glutamic acid (manfi) aur lysine (musbat), ke darmiyan bonds se juri hain. Yeh bonds hydrogen ion ki concentration ke liye hassas hain. pH ki koi bhi tabdeeli active site par amino acids ka ionise hona badal sakti hai, aur yeh substrate ke ionise hone par bhi asar dal sakti hai. pH ki shadeed tabdeeli enzyme ke bonds tor sakti hai, jis se denaturation hoti hai.

blocks.caption: Aham insani enzymes ka optimum pH (textbook table ke mutabiq)

blocks.alt: Reaction ki raftar aur pH (1 se 10) ka graph jis mein ghante (bell) jaise teen curves hain, har ek ki choti par nuqtedar lakeer: Pepsin ki choti taqreeban pH 1.6 par, Salivary amylase ki taqreeban pH 4.6 par, aur Pancreatic lipase ki, jo neecha curve hai, taqreeban pH 8 par.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.6: Kuch enzymes ka optimum pH aur pH badalne ka enzyme ki sargarmi par asar (kitab ki Figure 5.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har enzyme ki apni choti hai, yani apna optimum pH: pepsin (maide mein) tezabi (acidic), salivary amylase (munh mein) halka tezabi, pancreatic lipase (chhoti aant mein) alkaline. Choti se kisi taraf bhi pH badle to raftar girti hai. Kitab ki chhapi hui Figure 5.6 mein pepsin ki choti pH 2 aur pancreatic lipase ki choti pH 9 par hai, jabke kitab ka apna table pepsin 1.5 se 1.6 aur pancreatic lipase 8.0 batata hai. Yahan chotiyan table ke mutabiq (1.6 aur 8) banai gayi hain.

Enzymes bohat moassar hain, aur enzyme ke thore se molecules bari miqdar ke substrate ke reactions catalyse kar sakte hain. Enzyme ke qaboo wale reaction ki majmui raftar kisi waqt maujood enzyme ki miqdar par barah-e-rast munhasir hai, agar substrate ki concentration la-mehdood ho. Jab enzyme ki concentration barhti hai to zyada enzyme molecules aur zyada active sites hote hain, is liye zyada substrate molecules naye active sites se jur kar products mein badalte hain. Agar enzyme ki concentration barhti rahe magar substrate ki concentration wohi rahe to mazeed substrate molecules enzymes se nahin jur sakte, is liye raftar mustaqil rehti hai aur mazeed nahin barhti.

blocks.alt: Reaction ki raftar aur enzyme ki concentration ka graph. Lakeer origin se seedhi barhti hai, phir mur kar ek nuqtedar satah ke saath seedhi (flat) chalti hai; mor par teer ke saath likha hai No more substrate to attach with enzyme.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.7: Enzyme ki concentration ka enzyme ki sargarmi par asar (kitab ki Figure 5.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jab tak substrate wafir hai, zyada enzyme ka matlab zyada active sites aur zyada raftar, is liye lakeer seedhi barhti hai. Mor ke baad tamam substrate pehle hi enzymes se jura hua hai; mazeed enzyme ke liye substrate nahin bacha, is liye raftar barabar (constant) rehti hai.

Agar khali active sites wale enzyme molecules maujood hon to substrate ki concentration barhne se reaction ki raftar barhti hai. Agar enzyme ki concentration mustaqil rakhi jaye aur substrate ki miqdar barhai jaye to ek aisa nuqta aata hai jahan substrate mein mazeed izafa raftar nahin barhata. Jab enzyme molecules azaad hon (kam substrate concentration par) to naye substrate molecules dastiyab active sites se jurte hain aur diye gaye waqt mein zyada products bante hain, yani enzyme ke kaam ki raftar barhti hai. Jab tamam active sites masroof hon (zyada substrate concentration par) to izafi substrate molecules ko koi azaad active site nahin milti, is liye raftar nahin barhti.

blocks.alt: Reaction ki raftar aur substrate ki concentration ka graph. Lakeer origin se seedhi barhti hai, phir mur kar nuqtedar satah ke saath seedhi chalti hai; mor par teer ke saath likha hai No more active sites for substrate.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.8: Substrate ki concentration ka enzyme ki sargarmi par asar (kitab ki Figure 5.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Enzyme ki miqdar yahan mustaqil hai. Shuru mein khali active sites hain, to zyada substrate se raftar barhti hai. Mor par tamam active sites bhar chuki hain (saturation); ab mazeed substrate ko khali site nahin milti, is liye raftar aage nahin barhti.

blocks.prompt: Bonds ki madad se samjhayen ke thanda karna enzyme ko sust kyun karta hai jabke optimum se kahin zyada garam karna use bilkul rok deta hai, aur thermophilic bacteria 70 degree Celsius par kaise zinda rehte hain.
blocks.explanation: Thanda karna hydrogen bonds aur hydrophobic taalluqat ko sakht kar deta hai, to active site induced tabdeeli nahin kar pata, aur raftar girti hai magar enzyme salamat rehta hai. Shadeed garmi atoms ko itni shiddat se tharthrati hai ke yeh bonds zanjeeron ko apni jagah nahin rakh pate; globular shakal khatam ho jati hai (denaturation) aur sargarmi ruk jati hai. Thermophilic bacteria ke proteins ki polypeptide bazuon ke darmiyan bonding zyada mazboot hai, is liye un ke enzymes 70 degree ya zyada par apni shakal rakhte hain.

items: Darja-hararat: insani enzymes ke liye optimum 37 degree Celsius; is se neeche bonds itne sakht ke lachak nahin, is se upar denaturation globular shakal tabah karti hai. Thermophilic bacteria 70 degree ya zyada par kaam karte hain.

pH: har enzyme ka tang optimum (pepsin 1.5 se 1.6, trypsin 7.8 se 8.7, papain dono maholon mein); pH ki tabdeeli active site ke amino acids aur substrate ka ionise hona badalti hai, aur shadeed pH enzyme ko denature karta hai.

Enzyme ki concentration: raftar tanasub se barhti hai jab tak substrate kam na par jaye. Substrate ki concentration: jab tak active sites azaad hain raftar barhti hai aur sab masroof hone par hamwar ho jati hai.
